mood: Playful yet trustworthy, 3D interactive, bold typography, editorial spacing

headings.family: Outfit, Cabinet Grotesk, or Clash Display
headings.style: Bold, expressive, tight tracking (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter). Do NOT use Inter.
headings.scale: text-4xl to text-6xl (maximum text-6xl for hero, never text-7xl+). Hierarchy gap must be max 2 tailwind steps.

body.family: Satoshi, Plus Jakarta Sans, or DM Sans

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Optical Clarity' Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl, saturated, 1px delicate inner stroke border-white/40) for floating headers, tool panels, and modal overlays. Use 'Clay & Crisp' (Neumorphism with sharp 1px border) for dashboard widgets.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Generous corner radii: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for major cards to keep the 'fun/playful' vibe. Pill-shaped buttons.
visual_enhancers.borders: Never use solid thick borders. Use 1px borders with low opacity (border-black/5 or border-white/10).

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding p-6 or p-8.
grids_and_layouts.marketing_page: Bento 'Tetris' grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, wide gap-8/gap-12). Asymmetry and visual tension. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_workspace: Dense but rounded grid for the workspace. Grid items must be direct children. Override default stretch with align-items: start where needed.
grids_and_layouts.hero_section: Must feature a full-screen WebGL/3D background canvas with the UI chrome floating minimally on top. Text heavily contrasted. Max hero canvas overlay opacity bg-black/40.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Dynamic, responsive, bouncy. Every interaction needs a micro-animation.
motion_and_interactions.libraries: framer-motion for UI transitions, @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei for 3D backgrounds.
specifics: Hover states: translate-y-1, subtle shadow increase.
Custom cursor: Consider a custom Framer Motion cursor (glowing dot) if feasible, to match the k95/laxspace aesthetic.
Tabs transition: Use layoutId in Framer Motion to slide the active tab background smoothly.
Result cards (Green/Red): Use a bouncy entrance (type: 'spring', stiffness: 200) and a counter animation for the confidence meter.

component_strategy.marketing: Custom pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts. Do not use Shadcn 'Card' for landing page bento-use raw divs for asymmetry.
component_strategy.workspace_and_dashboard: Use Shadcn components (Tabs, Input, Buttons, Progress, Dialog) but deeply customize them: high rounded corners (rounded-full or rounded-2xl), paper-blue backgrounds, and remove the standard default borders.
component_strategy.navigation: Sticky header with crystal glass effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#EEF1F6]/70 or dark equivalent). Never fully transparent.

3d_libraries.implementation: Create a <Canvas> in the hero background. Add <Float> wrapping some primitive 3D geometries (e.g. <TorusKnot>, <Icosahedron>) or imported Spline models. Apply MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission (glass-like) or the deep navy/paper blue colors. Add mouse interactivity via useFrame to rotate/move objects slightly based on pointer position. Ensure adequate lighting (<ambientLight>, <directionalLight>).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over 3D backgrounds uses text-shadow or a gradient overlay to maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast. Dark text on paper-blue, white text on deep navy.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='verify-button').

image_urls.description: 3D abstract blue shape for background texture or feature card imagery.
Magnifying glass on blue surface. Great for the 'Image Checker' or 'How it works' section.
Teal LED futuristic scan panel. Use as a background for the dashboard or Payment Screenshot checker visualization.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone) or lucide-react. Ensure they match the playful but sharp aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk.
Do NOT make a standard centered SaaS layout. Build an asymmetrical bento grid for the landing page.

Make sure the hero section contains a 3D Canvas (@react-three/fiber) with floating, interactive geometries that reflect the deep navy and paper-blue palette. The user explicitly requested a 3D fun website like laxspace.co or k95.it.
In the TrueLense workspace, implement drag-and-drop zones for image/QR uploads with generous padding (p-12) and dashed 2px borders.
Result cards must vividly use #2F8F6F (Green) for real/verified and #C1443B (Amber-Red) for AI/fake. Add a confidence meter using Framer Motion progress bars.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds under text. Use solid #1B2340, #EEF1F6, or thick glassmorphism.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, inputs, tabs, and result elements.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
